draft.headline: US governors propose splitting AI regulation duties between Washington and individual states.
draft.threads_post:
US governors are proposing a split in how artificial intelligence is regulated. 

A bipartisan group wants Washington to set rules and review the most powerful AI models. Under the plan from the National Governors Association, individual states would keep authority to protect consumers.

Should Washington review big AI models, or should states lead?
